document.title: feat(fonts): colour emoji from Twemoji in the glyph atlas
document.summary: Slice 3 of the glyph-cache design: Twemoji 72 px PNGs ship under `assets/emoji`, and Text, Button and TextInput draw emoji clusters from them in colour through the existing RGBA8 atlas pages.
document.why: The approved [design](source:s1) asks for full Unicode coverage including colour emoji, with Twemoji as the art, and [Máté's review](source:s2) asks for an emoji in the smoke golden.

sources.title: Font glyph coverage
sources.gist: Approved design: dynamic glyph cache, fallback fonts, Twemoji colour emoji keyed by codepoint sequence; three PRs, this is the emoji slice.

sources.label: matemolnar8 on PR #90
sources.author: matemolnar8
sources.body: I would like the golden to contain an emoji and hungarian text. You can merge after that's added and verified.

lookFor: The [proposal](source:s1) lets the longest existing file win for ZWJ, skin tone, flag and keycap clusters. Done; when no prefix longer than one emoji has an image, the cluster draws as its first emoji and the rest of the cluster is swallowed.

The [proposal](source:s1) does not say when a symbol is an emoji. Here a codepoint below U+1F000 is an emoji only when U+FE0F or U+20E3 follows it, so `❤`, `©` and `™`, and emoji-presentation symbols such as `⭐` or `✅` typed without U+FE0F, still draw from the font.

The [proposal's](source:s1) smoke string `Újra 日本語 👍🏽 👨‍👩‍👧 🇭🇺` is not used. The golden draws 🎮 in a Text and 👍 in a Button label; skin tones, ZWJ and flags are covered by `glyph_cache_harness` only, and CJK waits for slice 2.
The [proposal](source:s1) credits Twemoji in the README. Credit is in `assets/emoji/README.md` (shipped in the VPK with the licence) and the SDK README; the root README is unchanged.
Manual step: `upload_vita` still FTPs only the eboot, runtime and DejaVu Sans, so a device needs this VPK installed once before emoji appear.

groups.title: Emoji clusters and atlas entries
groups.why: The [design](source:s1) keys emoji by codepoint sequence and loads them into the atlas on demand like glyphs.
groups.summary: `vd_emoji_cluster` parses a cluster into a `VdEmojiSequence`, and `glyph_cache_get_emoji` resolves its longest prefix with an image through an injected `VdEmojiLoader`, resampling it into the shared RGBA8 pages, which `glyph_cache_harness` checks with a fake loader.
lookFor: Perf: the first sight of a (font, size, sequence) reads a file per candidate prefix; a sequence with no image is remembered as a non-colour entry until `glyph_cache_reset`, and those entries are never evicted.
Subtle: an emoji that loads but finds no room this frame is not cached, so its PNG is decoded again on the next frame.
`clear_page` now also drops emoji entries that lived on the cleared page.

groups.title: Drawing and measuring by cluster
groups.why: Text, Button and TextInput must draw emoji, and wrapping must not split a cluster ([design](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `text.c` walks clusters instead of codepoints, `render.c` wraps and fits TextInput text by `text_cluster_width`, and `fonts.c` supplies the loader that reads `assets/emoji/<hex-seq>.png` through raylib.
lookFor: Behaviour change: U+200D and U+FE00–U+FE0F now draw nothing and have no width anywhere; before, they drew the font's missing-glyph box.
An emoji is a Font Size square whose top sits at the font's ascent; it advances by Font Size plus the 1 px tracking, and keeps only the text colour's alpha.
The TextInput keep-end fit now measures the whole value once, then drops clusters from the start until the rest fits, because clusters only parse forwards.

groups.title: Smoke golden with colour emoji
groups.why: [Máté's review](source:s2) asks for an emoji in the golden.
groups.summary: The smoke Button label gains 👍 and the refreshed golden shows it and the header's 🎮 in colour instead of the missing-glyph box.

groups.title: Glossary and SDK README
groups.why: AGENTS.md asks for the glossary and SDK README to stay accurate when author-visible behaviour changes.
groups.summary: The **Deck App Font** entry and one SDK README paragraph say emoji draw in colour from Twemoji and where they do not.

groups.title: Vendored Twemoji images
groups.why: Máté picked Twemoji (CC-BY 4.0) for emoji art in the [design](source:s1).
groups.summary: 4,009 unmodified Twemoji v17.0.3 72 px PNGs, renamed without `-fe0f`, with the licence and attribution; `CMakeLists.txt` adds the folder to the VPK. Skip the PNGs: they are binary copies.

commits.subject: feat(ui): colour emoji in the glyph atlas
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Emoji clusters (single, U+FE0F, skin tones, flags, keycaps, ZWJ) resolve
to the longest Twemoji sequence with an image, resampled to the Font Size
into the RGBA8 atlas pages and drawn untinted. A ZWJ sequence without an
image draws as its first emoji. Word wrap and the TextInput fit keep
clusters whole.
